objective: Introduce read-only bounded operational observation, deterministic health/incident classification, explicit owner/runbook routing and feedback-to-work-item proposals anchored to the exact SF-15 synthetic qualification and SF-14 source identity.
nonGoals: No live telemetry collectors, external service calls, deployment or recovery commands, tickets/PR creation, notifications, network, or production authorization
Never represent locally supplied observations as authenticated real health evidence or automatically resolve incidents
No change to CI gates, branch protections, unrelated project files, existing SF-15 fake deployment decisions, or real-world rollout
decisions: SF-16 consumes SF-15 qualification solely as a bounded, untrusted synthetic source binding, never a live deployment or authenticated source-acceptance proof.
Use exact closed schemas, UTC timestamps, signal allowlists, source/target digest binding, deterministic ID and capped event count; reject conflicting duplicates and ordering ambiguity.
Fresh healthy observations can mark recovery eligibility for manual review but cannot close an incident or authorize redeployment.
Missing, stale or unknown operational telemetry must remain unknown; incident owner/runbook and proposed work are advisory and require independent human/process authorization.

obligations.description: Reject malformed/duplicate/oversized/symlinked offline observation, qualification and policy inputs; require exact source/plan/target correlation and UTC ordered timestamps.
Classify healthy/degraded/failed/unknown and stale/missing evidence without ever asserting live monitored health, including recovery review rather than auto-resolve.
Deterministic bounded per-domain incident severity, owner, runbook, dedup identity and explicit uncertainty/recovery disposition from observed events.
Produce bounded idempotent work-item *proposals* with source/incident evidence identity, never automatic issue/PR creation or external effects.
Keep legacy source/interfaces unchanged; qualify exact stacked candidate on Linux/Windows with zero skips and source-bound evidence; avoid redundant Action runs.

structure: src/sf/operations.py: pure validator/classifier for source-bound observation input, health, incidents and proposed work
src/sf/cli.py: sf operations assess read-only, input controls and failure outcomes
docs/factory/SF16_OPERATIONS.md: synthetic vs live evidence trust boundary, incident/runbook/feedback operating protocol
docs/factory/evidence/SF-16.md: source-bound candidate evidence and exclusions
impact: New offline observation/incident protocol and work-proposal output only; no change to release, installer, deployment, CI, authority or other repos
Input consists solely of simulated/source-bound IDs, digest references, enums and timestamps; never ingest secrets or unbounded raw telemetry as work prompts

budget.network: none from runtime; GitHub API reads/writes limited to authorized s-f PR
budget.execution: Unit/negative tests plus native Linux/Windows required checks once stable; no hosted manual reruns

externalEffects: Only spsoftwarefc/s-f work order, allowed files and stacked PR #27; never deploy, access VPS, call live systems or create external issues
Keep #23–#27 unmerged, reserve next main merge for cumulative protected PR #28
All incident handling and ticket creation outside automation; policy does not grant incident/release authority
